FREELANCE SERVICE AGREEMENT

This Freelance Service Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into on 5th May 2026,

BETWEEN

Studio Loop Design LLP, having its principal place of business at 12 MG Road, Indiranagar,
Bengaluru, Karnataka, hereinafter referred to as the "Client",

AND

Mr. Arjun Mehta, an independent contractor and freelance UI/UX designer, residing at 45 Koramangala
4th Block, Bengaluru, Karnataka, hereinafter referred to as the "Freelancer".

1. SCOPE OF WORK

1.1 The Freelancer agrees to provide UI/UX design services to the Client as more particularly
described in the Statement of Work attached as Annexure A (the "Services"), including wireframes,
high-fidelity mockups, and a design system for the Client's mobile application.

2. DELIVERABLES AND TIMELINE

2.1 The Freelancer shall deliver the agreed deliverables in accordance with the milestone schedule
set out in Annexure A, with the final deliverables due no later than 30th June 2026.

3. FEES AND PAYMENT

3.1 In consideration of the Services, the Client shall pay the Freelancer a total fee of Rs.
2,50,000/- (Rupees Two Lakh Fifty Thousand only), payable in three (3) instalments linked to the
milestones set out in Annexure A.

3.2 Each invoice raised by the Freelancer shall be payable by the Client within fourteen (14) days
of receipt.

4. RELATIONSHIP OF THE PARTIES

4.1 The Freelancer is an independent contractor and not an employee, agent, or partner of the
Client. Nothing in this Agreement shall be construed to create an employer-employee relationship
between the Parties.

4.2 The Freelancer shall be solely responsible for payment of any applicable taxes, including income
tax and GST, on amounts received under this Agreement.

5. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

5.1 Upon full and final payment, all intellectual property rights in the deliverables created under
this Agreement shall vest exclusively in the Client. The Freelancer retains no rights to reuse the
deliverables for any other client without the Client's prior written consent.

6. CONFIDENTIALITY

6.1 The Freelancer shall keep confidential all business, technical, and design information shared
by the Client in connection with this Agreement, and shall not disclose such information to any
third party.

7. TERMINATION

7.1 Either Party may terminate this Agreement by giving seven (7) days' written notice to the other
Party. Upon termination, the Client shall pay the Freelancer for Services satisfactorily performed
up to the date of termination.

8. GOVERNING LAW

8.1 This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India, and the courts at Bengaluru shall have
exclusive jurisdiction over any disputes arising out of this Agreement.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the Parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.

CLIENT: ______________________          FREELANCER: ______________________
